crossRefs.note: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am…

parallels.note: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
translations.bsb: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. He put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink, saying, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down.”
translations.kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
translations.asv: And one ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to take him down.
